title: A protocol of rapid laboratory evolution by genome shuffling in Kluyveromyces marxianus
author: Wu, Wang, et al.

steps.title: Construct parental haploid strains
steps.instruction: Generate two stable haploid Kluyveromyces marxianus strains with opposite mating types and distinct auxotrophic deletions; delete the HML or HMR locus in each to prevent mating‑type switching; introduce a plasmid expressing the heterologous feruloyl esterase Est1E into the MATα strain (P2).

substeps.instruction: Delete HML/HMR locus in the parental background to obtain stable haploids.
Create strain P1: MATa ura3Δ his3Δ.
Create strain P2: MATα ura3Δ trp1Δ and transform with the Est1E‑expressing plasmid.

steps.title: Mate parental strains to form diploid library
steps.instruction: Mix equal numbers of the two parental haploid strains and allow reciprocal mating on appropriate solid medium to generate the first diploid library (D1).

steps.title: High‑throughput screen diploids
steps.instruction: Inoculate individual diploid clones from D1 into 96‑well microplates, grow them under standard conditions, and measure Est1E activity with the color‑based assay; select the clone(s) showing the highest Est1E yield.

substeps.instruction: Perform the color‑based Est1E assay on each well.
Identify and retain the top‑performing diploid clone(s).

steps.title: Sporulate selected diploid
steps.instruction: Transfer the chosen diploid clone to a sporulation medium containing limited nutrients and incubate until spores are formed, creating the first haploid library (S1).

steps.title: Screen haploid spores
steps.instruction: Subject individual spores from S1 to the same high‑throughput Est1E assay; for spores with high activity, determine their mating type and auxotrophic marker profile.

substeps.instruction: Measure Est1E activity using the color assay.
For high‑activity spores, assay mating type (MATa or MATα).
Identify auxotrophic deletions (ura3, his3, trp1, etc.).

steps.title: Select compatible haploids and remate
steps.instruction: Pair haploid spores that have opposite mating types and complementary auxotrophic markers, then mate them to generate the second diploid library (D2).

substeps.instruction: Match spores with opposite MAT loci and non‑overlapping auxotrophies.
Mix each compatible pair on mating medium.

steps.title: Iterate genome‑shuffling cycles
steps.instruction: Repeat the high‑throughput diploid screening, sporulation, haploid screening, and remating steps (steps 3‑6) iteratively until diploid strains with the desired phenotype (e.g., markedly increased Est1E secretion) are obtained.
